subject: D-INTEG-01 ACK profile/FEM class
body:
TASK: D-INTEG-01 ACK A-D-INTEG-01
STATUS: CANDIDATE. Not FEM_PERSIST_PASS. Not M2_PASS. Not BOARD_PASS.

CONFLICT_1 accepted: SEMANTIC_ID_WIDTH=32. SPEAR d_ref[31:24]==0 hard-code removed; id_ok is (d_ref <= active_id_max) from runtime_profile. Pack loader remains ingress of the same profile, not a second identity law.
CONFLICT_2 accepted: COMMITTED_CORRUPT is dest-integrity, not a fourth compaction state.
CONFLICT_3 accepted: FEM canonical = T2 DDR/MIG; word-atomic B0..B6 is not DDR crash safety; FIFO-empty != dest complete.

MIG APP_W still UNKNOWN. No architecture conflict opened.
M2: ID -> directory admit -> posting page. Null page pointer 0 reserved; first page at byte 16. edge_ref is T2 byte address.
XSim: M2_DIR_XSIM_PASS hit=235; M2_POST_XSIM_PASS rows=235. Not M2_PASS.
